notes: Shortest series-resistance path gives a conservative copper-only drop when assigning the entire Core current to each individual path; parallel copper paths reduce actual resistance.
35um outer /17.5um inner; 2mOhm via; contact/inductor/ground-return resistance, regulator ripple/transients and load regulation excluded.
TPS5430 Vref 1.196..1.245V and each feedback resistor +/-1% are design bounds, not measured output. Core official 0.5A requirement is not a peak-current guarantee.
85C copper sensitivity is a resistance model only; it does not qualify the complete board for 85C ambient operation.
